strings.name: Lachlan Murdoch
strings.role: Executive Chair and CEO of Fox Corporation; Chair of News Corp
strings.summary: Lachlan Murdoch is an Australian media executive whose career spans television, news and publishing in the United States and Australia. A son of Rupert Murdoch, he previously helped lead 21st Century Fox and now leads Fox Corporation and chairs News Corp. His career involves corporate separations, family control arrangements and debates over media governance.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Distinguishes companies and offices, family trusts and personal shareholdings, and corporate civil settlements and individual legal responsibility.
strings.influence.rationale: Participates in running Fox and News Corp, influencing news and broadcasting in the English-speaking world.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Graduated from Princeton University in 1994 with a degree in philosophy.
strings.facts.f2.label: Start of appointments
strings.facts.f2.value: Fox filings date his CEO tenure to October 2018 and executive chair tenure to January 2019; chairing News Corp does not mean being its CEO.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Media management across markets
strings.highlights.h1.text: His career covers television, news and publishing; he left an executive role in the family business, developed investment operations in Australia and later returned to group leadership.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Control and governance responsibilities
strings.highlights.h2.text: Changes to family trusts affect corporate control; Fox reached the Dominion settlement during his leadership, requiring distinctions between corporate and personal responsibility and between separate cases.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Comments on Fox quarterly results
strings.timeline.t1.text: As executive chair and CEO, discussed results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which was the first quarter of fiscal 2027.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Family trust dispute reaches agreement
strings.timeline.t2.text: News Corp announced a settlement of the Nevada family trust proceedings and new beneficiary trust arrangements.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes sole chair of News Corp
strings.timeline.t3.text: His father moved to chair emeritus; Lachlan did not take over the company's chief executive duties.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Fox settles with Dominion
strings.timeline.t4.text: Fox Corporation and its Fox News Network subsidiary agreed to pay $787.5 million to resolve their litigation with Dominion; this was not an individual criminal judgment.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Begins as Fox Corporation CEO
strings.timeline.t5.text: The 2026 filing identifies this month as the start of his tenure, distinct from the company's 2019 separation and stock-market debut.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Becomes co-chair of two companies
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became co-chair of 21st Century Fox and News Corp, which are distinct companies.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Develops Illyria investment operations
strings.timeline.t7.text: After leaving an executive role in the family business, developed a private investment company; filings list him as Illyria's executive chair from 2005.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Graduates and enters the family media business
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed his Princeton philosophy degree and began working in the family media business that year.
